notes: CartPole-only commissioning evidence; do not promote to humanoid/hardware capability.
Controller tuner candidates are accepted only if both held-out validation and held-out test improve.
Estimator calibration objective includes RMSE plus NIS/NEES consistency penalties.
Single-factor ablations precede the combined sim2real stress so failure causes remain attributable.

controlEstimationCoTuning.boundary: low-dimensional black-box co-tuning bridge; replace with differentiable/bilevel co-design at robot scale when tractable

safetySupervisor.boundary: runtime backup bridge only; no CBF/reachability/invariant-set safety guarantee

robustMpcProbe.interpretation: finite-model risk formulation does not improve the paired stress probe; uncertainty-set/objective/constraint/runtime design remains inadequate

interpretation.colored: innovation autocorrelation reveals a wrong white-noise assumption even when RMSE remains moderate
interpretation.dropout: stale packet metadata must be diagnosed separately from Gaussian measurement noise
interpretation.stuck: a plausible-but-frozen sensor value is a fault-isolation problem, not just an R tuning problem
interpretation.jitter: command-vs-applied mismatch exposes transport timing variation
interpretation.torque_speed: available input authority is state-dependent and belongs in the actuator/input constraint model
interpretation.thermal: available input authority becomes history-dependent and requires an actuator thermal state or derating model

discretization.warning: coarse integration materially changes the trajectory; validate integration before retuning control
